title: Acquire a whole attainable sign code under the cographic promise
statement: Canonical cographic support bounds its own description length before the hidden graph is acquired.

evidence.quote: ## 1. The scientific object: which interaction signs can occur together?

requires: Known n>=1 binary controls x in F2^n and chosen-setting scalar observations of f(x)=c+sum_i theta_i*(-1)^(a_i dot x), with distinct nonzero canonical masks a_i. A has those masks as rows. Promise: some edge-labeled undirected multigraph G, allowing loops, parallel edges and disconnected components, satisfies im A=ker B_G; equivalently the column matroid of A^T is COGRAPHIC. The graph, masks, coefficients and an external sparsity bound are not inputs. Requested configurations must actually be realized. Exact finite-bit rational observations or the stated independent centered subgaussian-noise model; accuracy/confidence and total observation/input encoding costs are explicit.
provides: C_f={Ax:x in F2^n} is the complete set of attainable interaction parity vectors. The two-control example -chi_x1-chi_x2-chi_(x1+x2) has independent preferred-sign upper bound3 but true maximum1.

B_G A=0 forbids nonloop vertex degree1 (a zero mask) and degree2 (equal masks). Each multi-vertex component has 2m0>=3v and cycle dimension rc=m0+ell-v+1, giving m0+ell<=3rc-3. One-vertex loop components contribute one dimension per edge. Thus m<=3 rank A<=3n; three-edge-connected cubic examples asymptotically attain factor3.

Set S=3n+1 internally, including the constant. This removes a supplied sparsity bound, not the cographic MODEL PROMISE. An arbitrary unobserved black-box spike can invalidate the promise and optimum while agreeing on all queried settings.
assumptions: Complete visible source derivations and implementation/experiments are received as a source-reported construction. Original proof PDF, code, results.json and substantive audit attachments remain unacquired under the P3 transfer hold; no new Capital rerun or audit overlay. Graph identities certify the ACQUIRED representation, not an unrestricted physical black box or absent unseen interactions. Wrong graphic/cut-space orientation contains Max-Cut; regularity alone is insufficient. Noise guarantee assumes realized requested controls and fresh independent observations; k-bit actuation flips attenuate a parity by (1-2p)^k and can require exponentially many observations. Arbitrary pinned controls/edit budgets/feasibility restrictions are outside the guarantee. No partition function, mixing-time result, quantum-state preparation, apparatus, historical priority or practical advantage is established. Earlier Maltsev work is preserved unchanged and uniform acquisition there remains unresolved.
costs: Canonical cographic support implies m<=3 rank A<=3n, so S=3n+1 includes the constant. Explicit deterministic field-hash acquisition costs (n+1)q^2=O(n^3 S^2)=O(n^5) exact evaluations for the smallest power-of-two q>=4Sn. Randomized noisy acquisition costs soft-O((n+1)S+sigma^2(n+1)S^2/epsilon^2), hence soft-O(n^2+sigma^2 n^3/epsilon^2), plus polynomial computation in those resource parameters and total encoding length. Full graph recognition, GF2 elimination, shortest paths, integer-cost blossom matching, observation repetition, precision/confidence, n-bit intervention communication, reset/preparation and physical measurement are paid. No sample-efficiency lower bound for optimization follows from a uniform-estimation comparison.
